MK9.1.title: Real-time pipeline panel
MK9.1.description: Dockable pipeline panel showing all 9 stages with status indicators (pending/active/complete/skipped/error), per-stage timing, and CSS transitions. Pipeline emitter wired into moke request flow emitting events for all 9 stages.

MK9.2.title: Pipeline detail expansion
MK9.2.description: Click any stage to expand detail panel showing entities detected, tokens before/after, model selected, cache decision, violations found. Detail data wired from emitter stage_detail records.

MK9.3.title: Pipeline history sidebar
MK9.3.description: History sidebar lists recent pipeline runs with status badges (complete/error). Click any run to replay stage progression with original timing. Server-side history via core pipeline history store (last 50 runs). GET /api/pipeline?count=N endpoint.

V3.2.1.title: Remove pub keyword from all moke source files
V3.2.1.description: Removed pub keyword from all function declarations (pub f= to f=) and type declarations (pub m. to m., pub m= to m=) across pages, src, and extensions.

V3.2.2.title: Replace qualified HTTP types with i64
V3.2.2.description: Replaced http.$req and http.$res qualified types with i64 in all page handler function signatures.

V3.2.3.title: Update match syntax to v3
V3.2.3.description: Replaced |{$ok:...;$err:...} match patterns with mt expr {ok:...;err:...} (lowercase, no $ prefix) across all affected files including sysmon, lokehealth, stream, agents, datasets, feedback, health, memory, pipeline, routing, mcp, ml API handlers, and streaming/companion_simulator enum matches.
